items: Questions often test which regulatory body controls foreign investment instruments like ADRs and GDRs (Answer: SEBI).
Note that both American Depository Receipts (ADR) and Global Depository Receipts (GDR) are categorized under regulated foreign investment instruments.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: SEBI acts as the governing body for foreign investment instruments.
American Depository Receipts (ADR) fall under SEBI regulatory oversight.
Global Depository Receipts (GDR) are recognized and regulated by SEBI.
